validation_contract.route_endpoint_rule: Every from/to ID resolves to territory_network.json or to a declared virtual maritime node.
validation_contract.adjacency_rule: Land adjacency is symmetric; island Iskara may have an empty land-neighbour list.
validation_contract.connectivity_rule: The undirected route graph is connected when virtual maritime nodes are included.
validation_contract.matrix_rule: For every market, export and import target shares each equal 100.0000 (+/-0.0001); all diagonal flows are zero; materialized global flow equals global_trade_units_index (+/-0.0001).
validation_contract.path_rule: A positive non-domestic flow has at least one feasible path unless explicitly marked blocked.
validation_contract.non_mapping_rule: No field names a real country, real port, or copied real bilateral flow.

tests.input: IPF max residual in share points

tests.expected: affected flows reroute or become unfilled; no extra global supply is created

failure_actions.route_failure: set route capacity to zero and recompute IPF with unmet-demand ledger
